<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/code/branches"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Foundation for the rich dropdown (PHASE 26b) — today the ref selector is a plain text field. `ahead`/`behind` are relative to the repository's DEFAULT branch; `null` when the provider can't compute it (an honest degradation, not an error). It is NOT `listBranches` (which the Gitflow bootstrap uses) — it is its own operation, because enriching costs an extra call to the provider PER BRANCH.
